children: China State Construction Engineering Corp. said Vice President Chen Yong is under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission over alleged serious violations of discipline and law, and is unable to carry out his duties, according to Ming Pao.
The company gave no further details.

title: China State Construction Vice President Chen Yong Under Disciplinary Probe
